webhooks.detail: Sherlock is an open-source local CLI, no hosted API, so no event subscriptions or webhooks.

evidence.quote: Hunt down social media accounts by username across 400+ social networks

sandbox.detail: Free open-source CLI, install and run locally (pipx/Docker); no account or sandbox needed.

evidence.quote: | `pipx install sherlock-project` | `pip` or [`uv`](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) may be used in place of `pipx` |

rate_limits.summary: not documented; no vendor API. Limits are per target site.
